desc: Read the integers $N$ and $K$, and the list of edges to construct the tree's adjacency list.
Perform an iterative Depth-First Search (DFS) starting from vertex 1 to determine the processing order (post-order) and parent pointers for each node.
Iterate through the nodes in reverse post-order (from leaves to root). For each node $u$, calculate the size of its subtree $sz[u]$.
During the calculation, count how many children $v$ of $u$ have a subtree size $sz[v]$ such that $sz[v] \% K \neq 0$.
If any node $u$ has more than 1 such child, set a flag to indicate impossibility and break early.
Finally, check if the flag indicates impossibility or if the total number of vertices is divisible by $K$ (which is guaranteed by the input format $NK$). Print "Yes" if valid, "No" otherwise.
